name: +1 Speed Horror Escape
desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Horror Escape! 🏃

How to Play:
🏃 Every step makes you faster
💪To run longer - train your stamina in the lobby
💰 Every checkpoint you reach gives you money
⚡ Unlock new pets that give leveling boosts
🔥 Rebirth to increase your maximum upgrade level

Second World is Coming out soon, turn on notifications!

If you’re having fun, don't forget to like the game! 👍
